Title: Public Preview: Set Java log levels in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
You can now set Java application log levels in Azure Container Apps without redeploying or restarting your apps. This feature, now available in public preview, allows you to dynamically adjust the verbosity of your logs and troubleshoot issues more easily.

Learn more.
